rationale: Repairs immutable CI reuse policy, bounds inferred task browser scope, prevents duplicate producers and separates verified green integration coverage from judged ranges. It preserves fresh guards and full beta/night/release authority without changing product behavior or baselines.

summary.ru: Целевые проверки задач и доказанный CI reuse устраняют лишние прогоны; база dev учитывает полные split-доказательства.
summary.en: Targeted task checks and verified CI reuse remove duplicate runs; dev coverage includes complete split-profile proofs.
